title: Run Manifest
description: Complete provenance record for one benchmark run. Written before measurement begins; timing-condition fields are finalized at run end. Must contain no secrets, account identifiers, or instance identifiers. Schema version 3.x: mock execution requires the mock engine, forbids GPU host fields, the container digest, and the model block, and uses the truthful not-applicable comparison classification; gpu execution requires a non-mock engine, the GPU host fields, the container digest, and the model block.

execution_mode.description: How the run executed: 'gpu' for a genuine GPU serving endpoint, 'mock' for the offline deterministic mock client (Phase 2). Mock runs must not fabricate GPU host details, and this field — not is_synthetic_example — is the execution-mode indicator.

run_id.description: Unique, non-sensitive identifier for this run (e.g. UUID).

is_synthetic_example.description: True only for synthetic example files committed to the repository. Genuine runs must set false; genuine manifests live outside the Git working tree and must never be committed.

commit.description: Full Git commit SHA of the benchmark code used.

repository.description: Repository URL for the benchmark code.

dirty.description: True if the working tree had uncommitted changes (invalidates the run).

model.description: The served model. Required for gpu execution; FORBIDDEN for mock execution — the mock client serves no model, and no workload/catalog digest may be misrepresented as a model artifact hash (the catalog digest lives in workload.catalog_digest).

artifact.description: Model artifact identifier (e.g. Hugging Face repo id).

revision.description: Artifact repository revision (commit) the weights were fetched at.

artifact_hash.description: Aggregate content hash of the model files (algorithm:hex). Digest length is algorithm-specific: sha256 and blake3 require exactly 64 hex characters; sha512 requires exactly 128.

precision.description: Numerical precision / quantization of the served weights.

license.description: License identifier of the model artifact (e.g. OpenMDW-1.1).

engine.description: Serving path. 'mock' is the offline deterministic mock client (execution_mode must be 'mock'; gpu execution requires a non-mock engine).

engine_version.description: Exact serving-engine version (and commit for non-release builds).

container_digest.description: Immutable container image digest (repo@sha256:...). Required for gpu execution; forbidden for mock execution (no container is involved).

environment_overrides.description: Non-secret environment variables affecting engine behavior (e.g. backend selections).

container_cuda_runtime_version.description: Actual CUDA runtime version observed INSIDE the running serving container (e.g. torch.version.cuda) — a separate fact from the driver's maximum supported CUDA version.

tool_call_transport.description: Wire protocol used for tool calls. openai-native-tools is the native OpenAI-compatible tools/tool_calls/role=tool path. The retired TOOL_CALL text protocol is never recorded here.

tool_call_parser.description: vLLM --tool-call-parser identity (qwen3_coder for Nemotron 3.5 Lightning / vLLM 0.27.1).

reasoning_parser.description: vLLM --reasoning-parser identity (nemotron_v3 for Nemotron 3.5 Lightning / vLLM 0.27.1).

engine_profile_id.description: Optional registered engine-profile identifier. Existing vLLM BF16 manifests omit this field and remain valid.

topology.description: Optional declared accelerator topology. Existing vLLM BF16 manifests omit this field and remain valid.

host.description: Host description. GPU fields (gpu_model, gpu_count, gpu_memory_gb, driver_version, driver_max_cuda_version) are required when execution_mode is 'gpu' and FORBIDDEN when execution_mode is 'mock' — mock runs must not fabricate GPU values.

gpu_model.description: e.g. NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

driver_max_cuda_version.description: Maximum CUDA version supported by the installed driver (nvidia-smi banner). This is NOT the container CUDA runtime version, which is recorded separately in serving.container_cuda_runtime_version.

cpu_model.description: Host CPU model as reported by the instance.

network_description.description: Advertised network tier/bandwidth of the purchasable configuration (no addresses or interface identifiers).

instance_type.description: Purchasable instance type / plan name (NOT an instance identifier).

region.description: Provider region name (zone allowed where applicable).

comparison_mode.description: Which comparison mode this run belongs to. Modes are never mixed in analysis. Mock execution must use 'not-applicable' (there is no serving resource to classify); gpu execution must use a real mode.

resource_limits.description: Container resource caps applied in controlled-resource mode: the JOINT total across the serving and benchmark workload (see methodology). Required whenever comparison_mode is controlled-resource.

list_price_usd_per_hour.description: On-demand list price basis used for cost measures.

price_source_date.description: Date the list price was sourced.

seed.description: Seed used, or null if the engine does not support seeding.

reasoning_mode.description: Frozen Nemotron thinking policy. true means the bundled chat-template default (thinking on) with --reasoning-parser nemotron_v3 separating reasoning from tool calls; reasoning content is never persisted. false means thinking disabled via an official chat_template_kwargs override. null means not applicable (mock).

allOf.$comment: Decision D-0024: catalog and sealed provenance are mutually exclusive. A sealed run (task_source.kind == sealed) records the executed stage aggregate only under task_source.digest and must not carry catalog_digest. Every other manifest (task_source absent or kind == catalog) is a catalog run and must carry catalog_digest with its original public-catalog meaning. Historical catalog manifests, which predate task_source, stay valid unchanged.

Decision D-0034: workloads 2.8.0 and 2.8.1, and any manifest that binds workflow-controller-v3, must record evidence_contract, validation_scope, and blind_generalization_evidence. Earlier workloads omit those fields and remain valid.

version.description: Workload/scenario fixture version (Git commit or semver).

controller.description: Agent controller bound to the executed workload contract (workload 2.5.0 binds evidence-grounding-v1; workloads 2.6.0 / 2.6.1 bind workflow-controller-v1, decision D-0031; workloads 2.7.0 / 2.7.1 bind workflow-controller-v2, decision D-0033; workloads 2.8.0 / 2.8.1 bind workflow-controller-v3, decision D-0034). Omitted for controller-free workloads; existing 2.3.0/2.4.0/2.4.1 manifests omit this field and remain valid.

evidence_contract.description: D-0034 evidence binding for workloads 2.8.0 / 2.8.1. Omitted by every earlier workload.

validation_scope.description: D-0034 validation limit. Omitted by every earlier workload.

blind_generalization_evidence.description: D-0034: this catalog cannot support an unseen-generalization claim.

catalog_digest.description: Content-address of the exact public scenario catalog used (canonical JSON, SHA-256). This is a WORKLOAD digest — it is never a model artifact hash. Present only for catalog runs; a sealed run (task_source.kind == sealed) must omit it and records its stage aggregate under task_source.digest instead.

task_source.description: Explicit task-source discriminator (decision D-0024). kind == catalog: tasks came from the public scenario catalog identified by catalog_digest and no sealed provenance is present. kind == sealed: every task came from one D-0023 custody stage; digest is that stage's aggregate (content-address of its task identifiers and content digests) and sealed_set is the content-free binding frozen in the qualification config. Absent in manifests that predate the discriminator (catalog runs). It never carries task bodies, identifiers, accepted answers, or filesystem paths.

digest.description: Aggregate digest of the executed custody stage. Equals sealed_set.stage_aggregate_digest.

sealed_set.description: Content-free binding of the executed stage, identical to the sealed_set section of the frozen qualification config.

custody_manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the custody manifest.json file bytes.

tasks_per_repetition.description: Task instances per measured repetition (measurement default 200, balanced across incident templates; decision D-0010).

scenario_count.description: Number of distinct incident templates drawn from.

warmup_description.description: Warm-up procedure applied before measurement (warm-up observations are retained separately, labeled, and excluded from measured summaries).

repetition_index.description: 1-based index of this repetition within the cell.

repetitions_planned.description: Planned repetitions for the cell (5 per the measurement contract).

notes.description: Any other timing-relevant conditions (must contain no sensitive metadata).
